demonstrated_defects.title: Up from Watch changes the selected title
demonstrated_defects.repro: Home with Acadia (or Forest) chosen; Down to Watch; Up. Focus and the check mark move to McWay Falls or Sea Otters, whichever middle card is nearest the centered Watch. Down from Sea Otters or Forest lands on Details.
demonstrated_defects.source_note: KidHomeScreen.tsx is unchanged between a672f57 and fbe53bf, so this predates fbe53bf

demonstrated_defects.title: Focus jumps to the page-top Back after a Reading comfort save
demonstrated_defects.repro: Parents, a kid chosen, Down to Reading comfort, Select. Off to On: the larger text pushes the focused row mostly below the visible edge and no scroll follows; the next D-pad press, in any direction, lands on the page-top Back. On to Off: the row stays in view but the next Down also lands on the top Back. With VoiceView on (720) focus moved to the top Back about 10 s after the save without a key.
demonstrated_defects.source_note: new with the Reading comfort feature in fbe53bf; the saved state itself is correct

demonstrated_defects.title: Pause announcement not heard on real pauses
demonstrated_defects.repro: VoiceView on, Dolby kept (Do not disable Dolby). Watch McWay, Resume; Play/Pause to pause; wait; Down and Up to show and hide controls; Play/Pause to resume; Play/Pause again. Nothing is spoken on either pause; the sentence was spoken once while the player was opening.
demonstrated_defects.source_note: VideoPlayerUI.tsx now calls announceForAccessibility when paused becomes true and the notice's live region is none; a672f57 with the polite live region did speak on pause (repeatedly). Cause not established.
